provenance.notes: lifecycle.finality=not_available with an empty players list, for the still-UPCOMING match 9501 -- afl-api's own contract never synthesises zero/null rows for a match that has not started (docs/afl-api-v1-contract.md section 1.4). Included so a round-scoped replay/scoring test that fetches player-stats for every match in the round (as app.calculations.MatchupCalculationService does) has a complete, valid response for all three of round_1500's matches, not just the CONCLUDED one it actually scores from.
